---
title: "09 — Reuse validation"
format: html
---

## Goal

Validate that the certified HCS data store can be reused safely by downstream scientific projects.

## Tests

- reconstruct representative artifacts from raw + config + code;
- verify checksums and catalog identities;
- query Peru and Chile subdomains without modifying master raw data;
- confirm expected spatial/temporal coverage;
- confirm units and coordinate conventions;
- validate derived-variable dependency chains;
- test `oceancube` extraction/matching on known control points and dates;
- verify machine portability using `config/paths.local.yml`.

## Release gate

A catalog/data-store version is reusable by paper repositories only after this step returns `GO` and the corresponding product/version records are frozen.
